description: This file defines utility functions for verifying the URL resolution of the /api/users endpoint, primarily for development and debugging purposes. It constructs expected API URLs, performs runtime logging, and checks query parameters to ensure correct configuration within a frontend project.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected URL for the /api/users endpoint, optionally overriding the organization ID for testing purposes, and verifies query parameters.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Runs a quick check by calling verifyUsersUrlResolution with a specific organization ID ('T0015') and returns the constructed URL for testing purposes.
